newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 24.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The China Securities Regulatory Commission has set 1997 as the year for risk control in the securities and futures markets.
- Experts say the set-up of a think tank for the central bank, the People's Bank of China, is an important step to improve monetary policy-making.
- Shanghai Petrochemical Co has been offered 700 million yuan in loans by the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Commentary says the automobile industry, in a slump in the past couple of years, is urgently in need of restructuring.
